verdict.rationale: Firstbase says it will legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state once you enter company details, and it offers onboarding for existing companies, so it does handle the change-of-agent filing itself. However, the evidence names only the incorporation state, and nothing documents each state's change-of-agent form or state filing fee; the published $299/state/year is Firstbase's own agent fee, not the state's. Missing for 10: per-state documentation of change-of-agent forms and state filing fees, confirmation that changes cover foreign-qualified states beyond the incorporation state, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the switch process.
